sunsetProviders.nativeSupportStatus: No native resolveProvider('fal') branch; fal.ai may be represented only through compatible newapi/generic configuration.
migrationConditions: A native fal provider path or documented generic/newapi compatible-provider path covers queue polling.
Auth tests cover fal.ai Key authentication.
Provider option tests cover ControlNet, IP-Adapter, image-to-image/edit fields, and result normalization.
Cancellation and failure normalization tests pass without FalMediaAdapter bridge execution.
sunsetProviders.removalTrigger: resolveProvider('fal') no longer enters createLegacyBridgeProvider() for supported image tasks and FalMediaAdapter has no runtime callers for those tasks.

migrationConditions: Native or compatible provider path covers Qwen image and Wan video requests.
Async task status polling, result download, retry/failure semantics, and result normalization are covered by tests.
Cancellation behavior is verified without DashScopeMediaAdapter bridge execution.
sunsetProviders.removalTrigger: resolveProvider('dashscope') no longer enters createLegacyBridgeProvider() for supported media tasks and DashScope smoke/unit tests run through the native path.

sunsetProviders.nativeSupportStatus: No native resolveProvider('kling') branch; generic/newapi can express some OpenAI-compatible scenarios but the kling provider type still bridges.
migrationConditions: The kling provider type maps to createNewAPIProvider() or is replaced by explicit generic/newapi configuration.
Image/video endpoint, provider options, async status, failure normalization, and result normalization are covered by contract tests.
Adapter registry no longer needs a distinct kling builtin legacy adapter for supported task families.
sunsetProviders.removalTrigger: resolveProvider('kling') no longer calls createLegacyBridgeProvider() and Kling contract tests pass through the native provider path.
